work: CFTR calnexin interactome remodeling & FRT siCANX Ussing asymmetry benchmark on Tedman et al. 2025 (CC BY 4.0).

claims.statement: Across 22 sample groups in FRT-F508del and FRT-WT Ussing workbooks (7 exact Col C == Col D duplicate replicate columns removed in FRT-F508del; 0 duplicates in FRT-WT), mean(Fsk+VX-770) > 0 and mean(Inh172) < 0 hold in 22/22 groups with pooled Pearson r = 0.991056 (FRT-F508del r = 0.998260; FRT-WT 9 non-ETI groups r = 0.993663; FRT-WT NT 45.71x FRT-F508del NT).
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/Copy of FRT-F508del_siCANX_Ussing-summary-for-paper.xlsx & Copy of FRT-WT_siCANX_Ussing-summary-for-paper.xlsx (CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.17632/ksfmxv8zts.1) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_canx_interactome_ussing/results_2026-11-25.json

methods.name: ElementTree float64 Ussing pooled reversal correlation
methods.difference: parses Raw-data-analyzed via ElementTree and computes 22-group Pearson r in float64

methods.name: minidom Decimal Ussing pooled reversal correlation
methods.difference: separate xml.dom.minidom OOXML reader computing 22-group Pearson r via decimal.Decimal

claims.statement: Under strict deduplication, siCANX shifts FRT-F508del 661+445 total activation by -31.55% (24.226667 [N=3] vs 35.393250 [N=4], ln ratio = -0.379067) and shifts FRT-WT DMSO by -27.74% (63.695250 [N=8] vs 88.149625 [N=8], ln ratio = -0.324926), yielding difference-in-differences log ratio = -0.054142 (as-deposited N=4 sensitivity reverses sign to +0.012454).
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/Copy of FRT-F508del_siCANX_Ussing-summary-for-paper.xlsx & Copy of FRT-WT_siCANX_Ussing-summary-for-paper.xlsx (CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_canx_interactome_ussing/results_2026-11-25.json

methods.name: ElementTree float64 DiD log-ratio evaluator
methods.difference: computes deduplicated group means and DiD log-ratio in IEEE-754 float64

methods.name: minidom Decimal DiD log-ratio auditor
methods.difference: independent minidom parser computing DiD log-ratio with 34-digit decimal.Decimal logarithms

claims.statement: Across 235 F508del-drug interactors and 372 CFTR-variant interactors (excluding CFTR=0.0 anchor and 3 #DIV/0! cells), minimum BH-FDR q-value across the 4 Drug canonical module attenuation tests is 0.640625 (folding, raw p = 0.160156) and across the 20 Variants module enrichment tests is 0.694575 (WT(-CX):folding raw p = 0.048141).
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/Copy of CFTR_Variants_LogFoldChanges.xlsx & Copy of CFTR_F508del_Drug_LogFoldChanges.xlsx (CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_canx_interactome_ussing/results_2026-11-25.json

methods.name: Array-DP Wilcoxon + pooled-rank BH-FDR
methods.difference: computes paired signed-rank p-values via integer array DP and float64 BH step-up

methods.name: Counter-DP Wilcoxon + Decimal BH-FDR
methods.difference: independent minidom reader using Counter subset-sum and Decimal BH step-up

claims.statement: Pre-registered Arm 1 hypothesis (FRT-F508del 661+445 siCANX reduction and disproportionate drop vs FRT-WT DMSO at Bonferroni alpha = 0.025) is refuted: Arm 1a two-sided permutation p = 0.085714 (3/35 splits > 0.025; Welch t = -2.746379, p = 0.058231; bootstrap 97.5% CI [-0.632096, -0.100299]) and Arm 1b one-sided stratified DiD permutation p = 0.408714 (450,450 splits; one-sided 97.5% upper CI = +0.224171 > 0).

Pre-registered Arm 2 hypothesis (>=1 canonical proteostasis module surviving BH-FDR q < 0.05 in BOTH Drug 4-test attenuation and Variants 20-test enrichment families) is refuted: 0/4 canonical modules pass Drug BH-FDR q < 0.05 (min q = 0.640625) and 0/20 module-variant pairs pass Variants BH-FDR q < 0.05 (min q = 0.694575); 10,000-draw label permutation null confirms calibrated FWER (0.0578 Drug, 0.0432 Variants).
